description: This file defines an Android activity class SendMessageActivity, which manages the UI and logic for sharing a text message with a contact via Android's Direct Share feature. It handles intent resolution, contact selection, and simulates sending a message.

classes.name: SendMessageActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that provides UI for sharing a text message with a contact, handling intent resolution, contact selection, and message confirmation.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the UI, resolves the shared intent, and triggers contact selection if needed.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles the result from contact selection activity, updating the contact ID and UI accordingly.

methods.name: resolveIntent
methods.description: Checks if the intent is a text share intent and extracts the message body and contact ID from it.

methods.name: prepareUi
methods.description: Updates the UI elements based on the current contact ID and message body.

methods.name: selectContact
methods.description: Launches contact selection activity for the user to choose a contact.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Simulates sending the message by displaying a confirmation toast and finishing the activity.
